messages:
Jordan: Deploybot just blocked RC8 during preflight — SBOM license ambiguity + low-severity vuln (CVE-2026-0001). Change window in ~2h. Need decision: pin to 2026-03-15 build, hotpatch, or timebox rollback?
security-bot: [AUTO] vuln-scan summary:
```
VULN: CVE-2026-0001 - libX 1.2.3 - severity: LOW
  - Remediation: bump to 1.2.4 (patch, no API changes)
SBOM: transitive license detected: "LICENSE-BSD-?" flagged for legal review
Scan-id: sv-2026-03-01-rc8
```
Mina: Blast radius? which services call the affected path?
Anika: Affected image: gcr/redwood/service:rc8. The transitive libX comes from our dependency tree only in the telemetry path, not in tokenization. Vector of exposure is low.
Anika: Options I see:
- pin libX to 1.2.2 (removes the transitive) -> quick, no rebuild of major deps
- bump to 1.2.4 -> rebuild + 45m QA + new image -> delays window
- rollback RC8 -> full rollback, restores previous image but loses fixes in RC8
Sam: QA quick check: RC8 is green for API surface we care about. No user-visible regressions in smoke.
Priya: Legal: ambiguous license string = distribution risk. I can sign a timeboxed exception for internal+hosted customers but public redistribution needs either clearer upstream license or a legal approval memo. If you link the upstream issue/PR I can expedite.
Jordan: My leaning: pin to 1.2.2 for this window to keep the rollout moving, schedule hotpatch to 1.2.4 for tomorrow's changewindow. Acceptable?
Mina: Fine by me if deploybot can apply a pin and mark the SBOM flag as acknowledged after Priya signs off for the exception. Need release notes updated to call out the temporary pin.
Anika: Pin command (dry-run):
```bash
/deploybot pin-version gcr/redwood/service:rc8 --package libX=1.2.2 --reason "temporary pin for SBOM license clarity"
```
deploy-bot: [ACTION] Pin request received for gcr/redwood/service:rc8. To apply run:
```bash
/deploybot apply-pin 1714507890 --approver Priya --notify #eng-releases
```
Note: pin will change image digest and create pinned-release metadata. Canary will stay blocked until pin is applied.
Priya: If you attach the sbom diff + upstream issue link I will review and (likely) approve within 30m. Please include any audit trail that shows the lib is only in telemetry.
Jordan: Attaching SBOM diff and upstream issue: http://github.com/libx/libx/issues/42 — upstream confirms license clarification pending, maintainer commented "clarifying license file". SBOM diff: removed transitive libX entry when pinned to 1.2.2.
Sam: :thumbsup: from QA. No objections.
Mina: I'll prepare release-notes snippet: "Temporary pin: libX -> 1.2.2 to address SBOM license ambiguity; hotpatch to 1.2.4 scheduled."
Priya: Reviewing now. If all looks right I'll post a signed approval in ~20m.
deploy-bot: Pin applied by Mina at 1714507960. Canary carveout: EU canary remains unpinned until hotpatch lands. Global rollout: UNBLOCKED (pinned). Release state: PARTIAL_ROLLOUT (PIN_APPLIED). Audit: audit/1714507890/pin.json
Jordan: Great — thanks everyone. Follow-up: Anika please schedule hotpatch build + canary for tomorrow morning. Priya please add the legal note to the release ticket when you sign.
Anika: On it. Scheduling hotpatch for 2026-03-02 08:00 UTC.
Priya: Signed off (timeboxed exception) and added note to release ticket: http://jira/redwood/RC8-RELEASE-1234 :white_check_mark:
Jordan: Closing thread, proceeding with pinned rollout. :party_parrot:
